nodes.label: DB Migration Policy (no destructive fallback)
nodes.rationale: fallbackToDestructiveMigration removed so upgrades never wipe users' reports; every schema change needs an explicit Migration. MIGRATION_1_2 verified on emulator upgrading from 0.1.0.

nodes.label: Idempotent sync via client_id
nodes.description: Each pushed report carries client_id '<install uuid>:<room localId>', unique per author, so retrying after a dropped connection updates the row instead of creating a duplicate. Push runs before pull so local work is never overwritten.

nodes.label: Cloud account
nodes.description: A Supabase auth.users record reached with email and password through GoTrue; reports sync and survive a reinstall. Only possible when the build carries supabase.url and supabase.anonKey.

nodes.label: Safety reports are author-only (RLS)
nodes.description: A report with visibility='private' is readable only by its author, enforced by the reports_select_visible policy in Postgres rather than by app code, so the client cannot leak what the server never sends. Safety categories are forced private when a report is created.

nodes.label: Free Supabase projects pause when idle
nodes.description: About a week with no API activity pauses a free project; it then returns connection errors and the app silently looks broken. Restore it from the dashboard. Free tier: 500 MB database, 1 GB storage, 50k monthly active users, no backups.
nodes.norm_label: free supabase projects pause when idle

nodes.label: Device profile
nodes.description: An on-phone identity: a display name the user picks, id 'local:<install uuid>'. Needs no backend, so the app is usable before any server exists. Signing in later adopts its reports.

nodes.label: Supabase backend (free tier)
nodes.description: Hosted Postgres + GoTrue auth + Storage chosen over a self-hosted Ktor server and over Firebase. Row-level security enforces report privacy in the database; pgvector and PostGIS are available for later AI and nearby queries; nothing has to be hosted or kept awake.

nodes.label: anon key ships, service_role never does
nodes.description: The anon public key is designed to sit in client apps and grants nothing on its own; RLS decides access. The service_role key bypasses RLS and must never reach the app, a screenshot or git.
nodes.norm_label: anon key ships, service_role never does

nodes.label: Runs with no backend configured
nodes.description: With supabase.* absent from local.properties, AuthRepository.isCloudAvailable is false, sign-in routes are hidden and everything works on-device. The intended default, not an error state.

nodes.label: Room is the source of truth
nodes.description: Every screen reads Room, so the app works with no signal; syncing happens to the local data rather than being something a screen waits on.
nodes.norm_label: room is the source of truth

nodes.label: No model API key in the APK
nodes.description: AI calls must go through a server-side proxy (ai.proxyUrl, e.g. a Supabase Edge Function) that holds the key. An APK can be unzipped and its strings read, and a leaked key is billed to us.
nodes.norm_label: no model api key in the apk
